cards.ex: The Thanksgiving feast is an integral part of American culture.
cards.exUz: Shukronalik kuni ziyofati Amerika madaniyatining ajralmas qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir muhim va ajralmas qismi, asosiy unsuri.

cards.ex: The vibrant parade will usher in the Lunar New Year celebrations.
cards.exUz: Yorqin parad Oy Yangi yil bayramlarini boshlab beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi davr, voqea yoki bayramning boshlanishini e'lon qilmoq yoki boshlab bermoq.

cards.ex: A funeral is a solemn occasion for those who are grieving.
cards.exUz: Dafn marosimi qayg'urayotganlar uchun tantanali marosimdir.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy, hurmat bilan o'tkaziladigan, muhim voqea.

cards.ex: The annual pilgrimage is a hallowed tradition for many believers.
cards.exUz: Har yilgi ziyorat ko'plab dindorlar uchun muqaddas an'anadir.
cards.uzDef: Qadrlanadigan va hurmat qilinadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: Once you get into the swing of things, you'll love the holiday rituals.
cards.exUz: Bir marta o'rganib ketsangiz, bayram marosimlarini yaxshi ko'rasiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga qiziqib ketmoq, ko'nikmoq, zavqlana boshlamoq.

cards.ex: We mark the Day of Remembrance with reverence for those who served.
cards.exUz: Biz Xotira kunini xizmat qilganlar uchun hurmat bilan nishonlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Katta hurmat va ehtirom bilan nimanidir nishonlamoq.

cards.ex: The city is a cultural mosaic, with celebrations from all over the world.
cards.exUz: Shahar butun dunyo bayramlari bilan madaniy mozaikadir.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar va urf-odatlarning aralashmasi, xilma-xilligi.

cards.ex: The festival pays tribute to the region's agricultural heritage.
cards.exUz: Festival mintaqaning qishloq xo'jaligi merosiga hurmat bajo keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimga yoki nimaga hurmat va ehtirom ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: The opening ceremony was a spectacle to behold with its vibrant colors and music.
cards.exUz: Ochilish marosimi o'zining yorqin ranglari va musiqasi bilan ko'rishga arzirli tomosha edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayratlanarli, ajoyib, ko'rishga arzirli tomosha yoki voqea.

cards.ex: A common thread in all cultures is the celebration of life events.
cards.exUz: Barcha madaniyatlarda hayotiy voqealarni nishonlash umumiy ipdir.
cards.uzDef: Turli narsalarni bog'lab turadigan umumiy jihat yoki xususiyat.

cards.ex: It's a family tradition for us to open presents on Christmas Eve.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvo arafasida sovg'alarni ochish biz uchun oilaviy an'ana.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari tomonidan avloddan-avlodga o'tadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: The holidays are a time of goodwill towards all people.
cards.exUz: Bayramlar barcha odamlarga nisbatan ezgulik vaqtidir.
cards.uzDef: Mehribonlik, do'stlik va yaxshi niyatlar hukm suradigan vaqt.

cards.ex: The party was in full swing by the time we arrived.
cards.exUz: Biz yetib borgunimizcha, partiya avjida edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir to'liq kuch bilan davom etayotgan vaqt.

cards.ex: The community came together to celebrate the town's anniversary.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat shaharning yubileyini nishonlash uchun birlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir maqsad yo'lida birgalikda ishlash, yordam berish uchun uchrashmoq.

cards.ex: We always look forward to the New Year's Eve celebrations.
cards.exUz: Biz doimo Yangi yil arafasi bayramlarini intizorlik bilan kutamiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bo'lishini katta qiziqish va umid bilan kutmoq.

cards.ex: Our travel plans had to be put on hold due to the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya tufayli sayohat re'jalarimizni to'xtatib turishimizga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik to'xtatib turmoq, keyinga qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: The anniversary of the tragedy is always a cause for reflection.
cards.exUz: Fojeaning yilligi har doim fikrlash uchun sabab bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy o'ylash va mulohaza qilish uchun biror narsa.

cards.ex: We observed the festivities from a distance, enjoying the atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Biz bayramlarni uzoqdan kuzatib, muhitdan zavqlandik.
cards.uzDef: Bayram marosimlarida ishtirok etmoq va ularni kuzatmoq.

cards.ex: The concert was held in celebration of the orchestra's 50th anniversary.
cards.exUz: Konsert orkestrning 50 yilligi sharafiga o'tkazildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir sharafiga, xotirasiga yoki shukrona sifatida.

cards.ex: The fireworks were a vibrant display against the night sky.
cards.exUz: Feyerverklar tun osmonida yorqin namoyish edi.
cards.uzDef: Rangli, hayratlanarli va jozibali namoyish.

cards.ex: The festival promotes cultural exchange between different communities.
cards.exUz: Festival turli jamoalar o'rtasida madaniy almashinuvni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar o'rtasidagi fikrlar, urf-odatlar va an'analarni almashish.

cards.ex: The dove is often seen as a symbol of hope and peace.
cards.exUz: Kabutar ko'pincha umid va tinchlik ramzi sifatida ko'riladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakka ishonch va ijobiy umidni ifodalovchi narsa.

cards.ex: The town has a strong sense of tradition and community.
cards.exUz: Shaharda kuchli an'ana va jamoatchilik hissi bor.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish bilan bog'liqlik va an'analarni hurmat qilish hissi.

cards.ex: The parade was a highlight of the city's anniversary celebrations.
cards.exUz: Parad shahar yubiley bayramlarining eng yaxshi nuqtasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim va qiziqarli qismi.

cards.ex: People gathered to pay their respects to the deceased leader.
cards.exUz: Odamlar vafot etgan rahbarga hurmat bajo keltirish uchun yig'ilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir o'limi munosabati bilan qayg'u bildirmoq, hurmat ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: We often look back on our childhood traditions with fondness.
cards.exUz: Biz ko'pincha bolaligimizdagi an'analarni mehr bilan eslab o'tamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqeani eslash va o'ylash.

cards.ex: The trip to Disneyland is a cherished memory for our family.
cards.exUz: Disneylendga sayohat bizning oilamiz uchun qadrdon xotiradir.
cards.uzDef: Katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan va qadrlanadigan xotira.

cards.ex: The holiday season is a time for giving to those less fortunate.
cards.exUz: Bayram mavsumi kam ta'minlanganlarga berish vaqtidir.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtojlarga yordam berish va xayriya qilish vaqti.

cards.ex: The wedding was planned in accordance with local traditions.
cards.exUz: To'y mahalliy an'analarga muvofiq rejalashtirilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar, an'analar yoki talablarga mos ravishda.

cards.ex: The flag is a symbol of unity for the nation.
cards.exUz: Bayroq millat uchun birlik ramzi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning birgalikda ekanligini va qo'llab-quvvatlashini ko'rsatadigan narsa.
